sources.title: ADD2852 Infrastructure work programme for 26-27
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's 2026-27 infrastructure work programme funds and governs projects under the Upgrading London's Infrastructure programme and explicitly covers connectivity, transport and infrastructure delivery activity.

sources.title: Social and Affordable Homes Programme 2026-36
sources.verified_claim: The Mayor states the 2026-36 funding round was significantly overbid; bids are being assessed after revisions focused on delivery confidence and value for money, with final allocations subject to agreement with central government.

sources.title: Time-limited relief from the Community Infrastructure Levy in London
sources.verified_claim: MHCLG opened consultation on a proposed time-limited relief from borough-level Community Infrastructure Levy for qualifying Greater London developments, intended as part of the Homes for London emergency package.

sources.title: Consultation on streamlining infrastructure planning: government response
sources.verified_claim: Government published its response on streamlining infrastructure planning, setting out reforms to reduce friction in major infrastructure consent and related planning processes.

sources.title: Making best use of land and achieving Good Growth
sources.verified_claim: Draft London Plan chapter 2 includes policies on optimising land and site capacity, utilities capacity/connectivity/resilience, sustainable transport enabling growth and design; it remains draft policy under consultation.

sources.title: Delivering the homes and neighbourhoods Londoners need
sources.verified_claim: Draft London Plan chapter 3 contains the current consultation policies on increasing housing stock, affordable housing and specialist accommodation; these policies are draft and are not adopted parcel evidence.

sources.title: Mayor publishes streamlined draft London Plan to boost affordable housing and support growth, jobs and the economy of the future
sources.verified_claim: City Hall describes the 2026 Draft London Plan as a new growth framework focused on affordable housing, good growth, jobs and future economic sectors, with consultation running to 15 October 2026.

sources.title: Overview of the Plan and Good Growth objectives
sources.verified_claim: The Draft London Plan overview confirms the document is the Mayor's proposed Spatial Development Strategy for Greater London and explicitly distinguishes current draft consultation policy from adopted policy.
